maya (People Ops): Heads up — the new welcome kiosk printed a stack of full 'VISITOR' stickers then started spitting out blanks. If you have guests, use the paper passes at the front desk for now.
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer error: PAPER_JAM_01. Attempting auto-restart...
olivia: Photographer just arrived with two guests. Where should they sit? :camera_with_flash:
sam: Meeting Room B is free. I'll grab paper passes and a sharpie.
dylan: Heads-up the big couch is reserved for the shoot crew for about 30 mins, might be best to use the lobby table.
maya (People Ops): @olivia there are spare paper passes in the badge tray — write names and stick them on. Apologies for the chaos. :grimacing:
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer status: ONLINE (firmware v3.2.1) — queued jobs cleared.
olivia: Got it, swapped passes. Also noticed a stroller + oversized parcel by the left doors with a UPS tag, anyone claiming?
sam: That's Tone Labs' promo crate, I'll move it to Parcel Locker A and DM the owner.
maya (People Ops): Quick poll — switch kiosk to manual name entry until vendor patch? React with :thumbsup: = yes, :thumbsdown: = no.
dylan: :thumbsup:
olivia: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
maya (People Ops): Thanks — will raise a ticket with the vendor and post an ETA. If anyone got a blank badge earlier, please swing by the desk to swap it for a proper one.
